_comment: Differences from the legacy site that were approved on purpose. scripts/parity-check.mjs ignores a text, link or font diff line that matches an entry exactly. Every entry needs a reason; anything not listed here fails the check.

text.+ Skip to content: Keyboard skip link, visually hidden until focused (accessibility; upgrade-plan §2.4).

links.+ a #main: Target of the skip link above.
links.- a /newsletter/10/1: Footer 'Visit our Newsletter' pointed at /newsletter/10/1, a 404 on the live site; it now points at /our-news (the newsletter page, already linked from the navbar).
links.- img /images/logos/hc-w.svg: The white navbar logo (#nav_logo_w) is display:none at every width; not ported.

fonts.- FontAwesome normal normal: FontAwesome 4.7 icon font replaced by inline SVG of the glyphs used (components/ui/icon.blade.php).
fonts.- Font Awesome 6 Free 900 normal: Font Awesome 6 icon font replaced by inline SVG of the glyphs used.
fonts.- bootstrap-icons normal normal: Bootstrap Icons font replaced by inline SVG of the glyphs used.
